config.notes: Course pages are www.newcastle.edu.au/degrees/<slug> (stored as plain fetches). The key-facts panel (CRICOS code, duration, location, mode, next start date, indicative fee) and the Similar degrees fee cards are filled by script in the browser, so the stored text carries no fee, campus, mode or per-course start dates. IELTS overall is read from the static line "IELTS overall minimum - X" (English proficiency requirements, under Apply as an international student). Intakes are read from the static note under Next start date ("Note: Semester 1 commences on 22 February 2027" / "Note: Trimester 1 commences on 1 February 2027"), which is the domestic default view and gives only the first term, not the full international intake list. The full international start terms are in <meta name="UON.Degree.StartDate.International"> (e.g. "Semester 1; Semester 2", "Trimester 1; Trimester 2; Trimester 3"), with IELTS in UON.Degree.IELTS.OverallMinimum / SectionMinimum and campus in UON.Degree.Location - not readable by text patterns today. Calendar: https://www.newcastle.edu.au/__data/assets/pdf_file/0005/1137173/Academic-Calendar-2027.pdf (2027: Sem 1 22 Feb, Midyear 21 Jun, Sem 2 16 Aug, Tri 1 1 Feb, Tri 2 10 May, Tri 3 16 Aug). handbook.newcastle.edu.au is robots-disallowed.
